colleges.notes: Scanned prospectus (17 image pages, no text layer); page 13 read from the rendered image. 'Gen' = the UT column (our roster's DD Seats and DNH Seats); our roster's 'Other State Seats' (2) are not named in the table. Seat table p.3: Management Quota 4 seats (DVL, Gen Med, OBG, Ortho, Radio-Diagnosis), NRI 2 (Gen Med, Paediatrics); a '--' cell = no seat. Fee 'subject to revision from time to time'. AIQ: this prospectus has NO AIQ column. The separate AIQ sheet (round-1 file 'Fee Structure and Bond Details AIQ', 17 Oct 2026) prints the same 12 figures as this UT column but still carries no year — the AIQ figure stays the owner's decision (round-1 dadra_and_nagar_haveli.json, not_published → unlabelled_candidate).
